backward_compat_traps.rule: TPM 1.2 used TPM_TAG_RQU_COMMAND = 0x00C1; TPM 2.0 uses TPM_ST_NO_SESSIONS = 0x8001.
backward_compat_traps.trap: A legacy driver speaking TPM 1.2 tag to a TPM 2.0 device receives TPM_RC_BAD_TAG.

backward_compat_traps.rule: Command code numeric values are disjoint between TPM 1.2 and TPM 2.0.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Same numeric value may map to different / no commands.

backward_compat_traps.rule: TPM 2.0 may have ZERO SHA1 banks (allocated out).
backward_compat_traps.trap: Legacy code that assumes SHA1 PCRs exist fails.

backward_compat_traps.rule: TPM2_PCR_Allocate only stages the change; takes effect after TPM2_Startup.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Code that issues PCR_Allocate then immediately reads new bank fails.

backward_compat_traps.rule: TPMA_SESSION.continueSession=0 flushes the session after the command.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Caller losing the session unexpectedly between commands.

backward_compat_traps.rule: Restricted signing keys (e.g. AK) sign only TPM-internally-produced digests.
backward_compat_traps.trap: External attempts to sign arbitrary host-supplied digests return TPM_RC_TICKET / TPM_RC_KEY.

backward_compat_traps.rule: After maxAuthFail wrong authValue tries, TPM enters lockout until lockoutAuth issues TPM2_DictionaryAttackLockReset.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Brute-force password sweeps quickly lock out legitimate access.
Calling TPM2_EvictControl with a 0x4xxxxxxx address fails.

Wide deployment; added Locality, AIK, DRTM, NV storage; still RSA + SHA1.

Errata, ECDAA additions; shipped with Windows 10.

Host-side libraries: tpm2-tss, FAPI, ESAPI, SAPI, TCTI.

fields.version_naming_history_note: The TPM Library Specification is managed by the Trusted Computing Group (TCG). 'Family 2.0' is the major version; Level + Revision identify the spec drop. Part 1 (Architecture), Part 2 (Structures), Part 3 (Commands), Part 4 (Supporting Routines) ship as a single set. ISO/IEC 11889 is the parallel international standard that mirrors the TCG releases.

key_changes.summary: Algorithm-agile library replaces fixed RSA-2048 + SHA1; ECC support added; SHA-256/384/512 / SM3 support added; HMAC + Policy session types added; PCR banks per algorithm.
First public release; minor errata and command-code stabilization.
